facts.text: The hotel sits at the confluence of the Bouregreg River and the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Nestled at the confluence of the Bouregreg and the Atlantic Ocean, offering breathtaking views of the region’s storied landmarks

facts.text: The building is designed to mirror a cruise liner dropping anchor on the estuary.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont La Marina Rabat Salé is designed to mirror a majestic cruise liner dropping anchor on the estuary

facts.text: Its open, interconnected spaces blend traditional craftsmanship and Moroccan artistry with modern materials.
facts.excerpt: In the open, interconnected spaces, traditional craftsmanship blends modern materials and Moroccan artistry with unexpected flair.

facts.text: The hotel is on Fes Avenue, in front of the Marina of Salé, 10 minutes from Rabat city center and a 20-minute drive from Rabat International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont La Marina Rabat-Salé is located at Fes Avenue, in front of the striking modern Marina of Salé. The hotel is 10 minutes away from Rabat city center, a 20-minute drive from Rabat International Airport

facts.text: Rooms have bay windows and views of the estuary.
facts.excerpt: With bay windows soaking up the warmth of natural light, breathtaking views of the estuary, and lavish bathrooms appointed with the utmost amenities

facts.text: Fairmont rooms have a workspace fusing historical details with contemporary items crafted by local artists.
facts.excerpt: a workspace fusing subtle historical details with contemporary items crafted by local artists

facts.text: The Ocean Suite has a 43-square-meter private terrace looking out at the confluence of the Bouregreg River and the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Gaze out over your 43 m2 private terrace at the wonderful confluence of the currents of the Bouregreg River and the Atlantic Ocean.

facts.text: The Heritage Gold Suite has a private terrace of over 65 square meters with a view of the Kasbah.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a private terrace over 65m2, offering a breathtaking view of the Kasbah

facts.text: The three-bedroom Ambassador Gold Suite has a terrace of over 162 square meters and pays tribute to HRH Princess Lalla Aicha, the first female ambassador in the Arab world.
facts.excerpt: With a terrace of over 162m2 overlooking iconic landmarks, 3 bedrooms, Two kings and One with two Queens Beds, delicate yet intricate artwork selection this Suite pays tribute to HRH Princess Lalla Aicha

facts.text: Fairmont Gold rooms give access to the Fairmont Gold lounge with sea views, serving breakfast, afternoon canapés and evening hors d'oeuvres.
facts.excerpt: providing access to the luxury of Fairmont Gold lounge with its stunning sea views, featuring breakfast, afternoon canapés, happy hour and evening hors d'ceuvres

facts.text: The spa offers a Hammam experience using marocMaroc products.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a spellbinding Hammam experience featuring marocMaroc products

facts.text: The rooftop offers a Greek-inspired, Mediterranean dining experience with sea breeze.
facts.excerpt: Gaze in awe from our rooftop, where gentle waves and sea breeze set the tone for a Greek-inspired experience, brimming with colors and flavors.

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: Rooftop Pool

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly.
facts.excerpt: Pet-Friendly

facts.text: The hotel offers a Rabat night city tour showing illuminated landmarks.
facts.excerpt: Explore Rabat by night, as it reveals its splendor through lighting schemes highlighting landmarks and iconic spots

facts.text: The head concierge, Jaafar, is a Clés d'Or concierge.
facts.excerpt: Our head concierge Jaafar is a clés d'or concierge

facts.text: There is underground parking with electric-car charging terminals and a valet parking service.
facts.excerpt: an underground parking facility including terminals for electrical powered cars, along with a valet parking service

facts.text: The hotel is 1 hour 30 minutes from Casablanca International Airport.
facts.excerpt: and 1h30m from Casablanca International Airport

facts.text: Fairmont View rooms have a balcony overlooking the twin cities and a bathroom with an Italian shower and a bathtub.
facts.excerpt: From your balcony, the twin cities unfold like a masterpiece, while the in-room details echos their history. Treat yourself to a restorative night thanks to our Sealy bedding, and unwind in a lavish bathroom with an italian shower and a bathtub.

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Center
